responsibility: This machine-description fragment contains the automaton-based scheduler model for the Qualcomm Falkor microarchitecture. It defines Falkor execution units, reservations, latencies, and bypasses for scalar integer, branch, load/store, floating-point, SIMD, crypto, and multiply/divide instruction classes, keyed by the generated tune attribute, so the generic AArch64 scheduler can model Falkor-specific issue resources and instruction timing.
